links.outcome: Differences in current AI chatbot use by parent sex and income
links.effect: Current AI chatbot use favored male parents (OR 2.5, 95% CI 1.1-6.0) and higher-income parents (OR 3.8, 95% CI 1.1-12.7).
links.quote: Significant socioeconomic disparities in current AI chatbot use favored male (OR 2.5, 95% CI 1.1-6.0) and higher income (OR 3.8, 95% CI 1.1-12.7) parents.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey evaluating parental attitudes and socioeconomic disparities regarding AI chatbot usage for health information in a pediatric intensive care unit setting.
